concept.name: Autoencoder
concept.definition: A neural network trained to reconstruct its input through a constrained latent representation produced by an encoder and decoded back to input space.
concept.intuition: It is a learnable mapping or representation used to turn features into predictions or groups.
concept.mechanics: Pass training inputs through encoder and decoder, minimize reconstruction loss, then use latent codes or reconstruction errors for downstream analysis.
concept.failure_modes: Flexible models can fit noise, shift under new regimes, and conceal instability when tuning is repeated on the same validation data.
concept.misconceptions: Greater model complexity or in-sample accuracy does not by itself imply better out-of-sample trading results.
concept.example: An autoencoder trained on normal returns flags a day whose reconstruction error exceeds the training threshold as anomalous.

citations.source: Keras example, Timeseries anomaly detection using an Autoencoder
